metadata.name: ga4_export__events_report
metadata.comment: GA4 report that tracks interactions (events) across the app or website, summarizing event counts, total revenue generated from events, users, and more.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.comment: The name of the event recorded.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source relation for the data.

event_count.name: event_count
event_count.comment: The total number of events recorded.

event_count_per_user.name: event_count_per_user
event_count_per_user.comment: Average number of events per user, rounded to 2 decimal places.

total_revenue.name: total_revenue
total_revenue.comment: The sum of ecommerce_purchase_revenue, defaulting to 0 if null.

total_users.name: total_users
total_users.comment: The total number of distinct user_pseudo_ids.

unique_key.name: unique_key
unique_key.comment: A unique field for each record generated by a combination of event_date, event_name, and source_relation.

metadata.name: ga4_export__sessions_enhanced
metadata.comment: Tracks user sessions across the app or website, summarizing session engagement, start and end times, total events, and more to analyze user behavior during sessions.

session_id.name: session_id
session_id.comment: A unique identifier for each session, used as the primary key.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source relation for the data.

session_start_time.name: session_start_time
session_start_time.comment: Timestamp indicating when the session started.

session_end_time.name: session_end_time
session_end_time.comment: Timestamp indicating when the session ended.

total_session_engagement_time_sec.name: total_session_engagement_time_sec
total_session_engagement_time_sec.comment: The total engagement time during the session, in seconds, calculated as the sum of engagement time across all events.

total_events.name: total_events
total_events.comment: The total number of events recorded during the session.

is_engaged_session.name: is_engaged_session
is_engaged_session.comment: A boolean indicating whether the session was considered "engaged," where 1 indicates an engaged session and 0 indicates a non-engaged session.

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

session_source.name: session_source

total_sessions.name: total_sessions

engagement_rate.name: engagement_rate

events_per_session.name: events_per_session
events_per_session.comment: Average number of events per session, rounded to 2 decimal places.

key_events.name: key_events

user_engagement_duration.name: user_engagement_duration

metadata.name: stg_ga4_export__event
metadata.comment: Each record represents an event triggered by a user in GA4, containing details such as event name, timestamp, user ID, and associated parameters.

fivetran_id.name: fivetran_id
fivetran_id.comment: The unique identifier for this record.

event_id.name: event_id
event_id.comment: The key generated from a combination of 'user_pseudo_id' (if not available, returns an empty value), 'event_timestamp', 'event_name', 'bundle_sequence_id', and 'batch_event_index'.

fivetran_synced.name: fivetran_synced
fivetran_synced.comment: Timestamp indicating when this record was last synced from the source.

bundle_sequence_id.name: bundle_sequence_id
bundle_sequence_id.comment: The sequence ID of the bundle in which these events were uploaded.

batch_event_index.name: batch_event_index
batch_event_index.comment: A number indicating the sequential order of each event within a batch based on their order of occurrence on the device.

event_date.name: event_date
event_date.comment: The date when the event occurred.

device_category.name: device_category
device_category.comment: The category of the device used (e.g., mobile, desktop).

geo_city.name: geo_city
geo_city.comment: The city where the event was triggered.

geo_country.name: geo_country
geo_country.comment: The country where the event was triggered.

geo_region.name: geo_region
geo_region.comment: The region where the event was triggered.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.comment: The name of the event, such as 'purchase', 'user_engagement'.

platform.name: platform
platform.comment: The platform on which the event occurred (e.g., iOS, Android).

event_timestamp.name: event_timestamp
event_timestamp.comment: The timestamp when the event occurred.

source_medium.name: source_medium
source_medium.comment: The "type" of channel that the traffic comes from (organic search, paid search, referral, etc). This is a coalesce between collected_traffic_source_manual_medium and traffic_source_medium and param_medium.

source_source.name: source_source
source_source.comment: Location where your website’s traffic comes from (Google, Facebook, Quora, etc). This is a coalesce between collected_traffic_source_manual_source and traffic_source_source and param_source.

user_first_touch_timestamp.name: user_first_touch_timestamp
user_first_touch_timestamp.comment: The timestamp of the user's first touch.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: The unique identifier for the user.

user_pseudo_id.name: user_pseudo_id
user_pseudo_id.comment: The unique pseudo-identifier for the user, used to track anonymous user sessions.

event_value_usd.name: event_value_usd
event_value_usd.comment: The monetary value associated with this event, in USD.

ecommerce_purchase_revenue_usd.name: ecommerce_purchase_revenue_usd
ecommerce_purchase_revenue_usd.comment: The revenue from ecommerce purchases in USD.

ecommerce_purchase_revenue.name: ecommerce_purchase_revenue
ecommerce_purchase_revenue.comment: Purchase revenue of this event, represented in local currency with standard unit. Populated for purchase event only.

ecommerce_refund_value_usd.name: ecommerce_refund_value_usd
ecommerce_refund_value_usd.comment: The value of refunds in USD.

ecommerce_refund_value.name: ecommerce_refund_value
ecommerce_refund_value.comment: The amount of refund in this event, represented in local currency with standard unit. Populated for refund event only.

ecommerce_total_item_quantity.name: ecommerce_total_item_quantity
ecommerce_total_item_quantity.comment: The total quantity of items in ecommerce transactions.

ecommerce_transaction_id.name: ecommerce_transaction_id
ecommerce_transaction_id.comment: The identifier for the ecommerce transaction.

event_dimensions_hostname.name: event_dimensions_hostname
event_dimensions_hostname.comment: The hostname associated with the event.

param_video_duration.name: param_video_duration
param_video_duration.comment: The duration of the video in milliseconds.

param_percent_scrolled.name: param_percent_scrolled
param_percent_scrolled.comment: The percentage of the page scrolled.

param_campaign.name: param_campaign
param_campaign.comment: The campaign associated with the event.

param_gclid.name: param_gclid
param_gclid.comment: The Google Click ID associated with the event.

param_medium.name: param_medium
param_medium.comment: The medium associated with the event.

param_source.name: param_source
param_source.comment: The source associated with the event.

param_ga_session_id.name: param_ga_session_id
param_ga_session_id.comment: The GA session ID associated with the event.

param_ga_session_number.name: param_ga_session_number
param_ga_session_number.comment: The session number for the user.

param_engagement_time_msec.name: param_engagement_time_msec
param_engagement_time_msec.comment: The time spent by the user engaging with the app or website, in milliseconds.

param_engaged_session_event.name: param_engaged_session_event
param_engaged_session_event.comment: Whether the event was part of an engaged session.

param_session_engaged.name: param_session_engaged
param_session_engaged.comment: Whether the user was engaged during the session.

stream_id.name: stream_id
stream_id.comment: Unique identifier for the data stream from which user activity originates. This can be from iOS, Android, and Web.

is_intraday.name: is_intraday
is_intraday.comment: A flag for events that originated from the intraday table, a table representing current day events that gets updated throughout the day.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. For example, this could be the case if you're syncing multiple properties.

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
